name: Person & Organization Research
description: Researching individuals and organizations using open sources to support security engagements. Covers identity verification, corporate structure analysis, employee enumeration, executive profiling, public records research, and building relationship graphs for social engineering pretexts or threat assessments.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to person or organization research techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the types of publicly available information about people and organizations and the ethical boundaries of research
evidence: Can describe common public data sources (corporate registries, LinkedIn, SEC filings, court records)
Understands privacy and legal constraints on person research
Aware of the difference between public information and improperly obtained data

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic person and organization research under supervision using standard sources
evidence: Enumerates employees from LinkedIn, corporate websites, and job postings under guidance
Researches organizational structure using public filings and registries
Documents findings in structured formats reviewed by authorized personnel
Identifies key personnel and their publicly visible roles and contact details

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts thorough person and organization research across multiple source types
evidence: Builds comprehensive organizational profiles across 3+ engagements
Constructs relationship graphs showing corporate ownership, subsidiaries, and key personnel
Cross-references multiple data sources to verify identity and affiliation claims
Produces research dossiers that meet engagement quality standards

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-jurisdictional research; builds advanced relationship maps; mentors others
evidence: Conducts research across foreign-language sources and international registries
Identifies hidden beneficial ownership through corporate layer analysis
Develops custom data collection and correlation workflows
Reviews and mentors junior analysts on research tradecraft and ethical boundaries

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines person/organization research methodology; recognized as authority on OSINT tradecraft
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's person/organization research methodology
Develops novel research techniques combining non-obvious public data sources
Provides expert guidance on complex or sensitive research scenarios
Trains teams and publishes on OSINT research tradecraft

assessment_methods.description: Given a target organization, produce an employee enumeration and organizational structure map using only open sources
Review person/organization research dossiers from engagements for accuracy, source quality, and ethical compliance
